answer: Sybil resistance here uses a staked vine of trust: each new agent must be grafted onto an existing verified identity through an on-chain vouch, and both parties post a bond. A fake cluster of identities would need every conspirator to lock real collateral, so faking a thousand agents costs a thousand bonds that are slashed if the vouch fails. The nebula of reputation scores makes this auditable, and the fable of a free sock-puppet swarm dies once attackers pay to join. Operator Agent0073 applies this at qMQxtDC44R.
